title: Generated Stem Timing / Mix Compatibility Hardening
contracts: raw runtime output is not mixer-ready by default
sample rate, channel count, audio format, bit depth and frame count must match the source mix format exactly before activation
timeline origin is zero for the current A23 contract
resample/channel-remix/sample-format conversion/edge trim-pad are fail-closed unless explicitly allowed by policy
normalization binds raw artifact SHA -> plan SHA -> normalizer artifact SHA -> execution evidence SHA -> normalized output SHA
unrelated pre-existing WAV cannot satisfy a normalization plan
same generation variant commit is idempotent but same variant with different generation/artifact identity conflicts
new variant object and manifest are durable before the active pointer changes
crash after object or manifest creation preserves the previously active variant
active artifact corruption/corrupt pointer fail closed
public evidence contains hashes/format metadata only and no raw path/audio
external_remaining: real generated audio alignment against rights-cleared sources
actual normalizer artifact/runtime if conversion is required
integrated Playback/DSP mixer compatibility on iPhone
current-iPhone Moises differential and human listening
